description: Synthetic real-world supply-list phrasings with expected parses for the Phase 3 parsing corpus. Every phrasing is invented fixture content; none is copied from any school-hosted document.

provenance.limitations: Synthetic corpus for parser regression testing only. Expected values were generated by running the deterministic parser and hand-verifying each against the phrasing's plain meaning; they assert parser behavior, not real product data.

records.phrasing: 1 red plastic pocket folder with prongs
3 containers of disinfecting wipes (Clorox or Lysol)
1 4-pack Expo dry erase markers, low odor
6 black dry erase markers, low odor
wired over-ear headphones (no earbuds, no bluetooth)
backpack - no wheels, no character prints, solid colors only
